incident-bot: @channel ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected from edge-proxy-us-east-1 -> backend fanout. error type: upstream_timeout / 502s. rate: 18% over 5m threshold. paging oncall. :rotating_light:
eric (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing dashboards and PG logs now.
maria (infra): noticed a spike in upstream timeouts with ELB 504s too. seems concentrated on egress-proxy nodes e-p-2 and e-p-3.
sanjay (runtime): checking model serving pools — no heavy queueing on model hosts. KV cache hit rates look normal.
eric (oncall): can we confirm if recent routing policy change rolled out to us-east? I saw a config PR earlier.
maria (infra): yes, a small routing tweak merged ~20m ago to favor regional egress for cost reasons. PR: https://git.internal/routing/PR/3421
tom (sre): past incidents — routing changes causing connection storm to a small subset of proxies. if egress-proxy backends got uneven fanout that explains 502s.
eric (oncall): ok trying a quick mitigation: flip routing flag to previous canary. pinging deploy-bot to rollback.
deploy-bot: @eric (oncall) rollback started: routing/config v1.14 -> v1.13. ETA ~45s.
julia (product): are customers impacted? Any large tenant errors?
eric (oncall): initial telemetry shows increased 5xx for general API surface, but top affected customers are low-volume. SLO impact: small but visible. I'll prepare a customer note draft after we stabilize.
sanjay (runtime): while rollback is in progress, can we add a temporary circuit-breaker on edge-proxy to limit fanout concurrency to 8 per request? that should reduce cascading failures.
maria (infra): applying temp Envoy circuit-break rule to e-p-2/e-p-3. patch:```
# envoy route config snippet
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    - max_connections: 10000
      max_pending_requests: 1000
      max_requests: 5000
      max_retries: 1
```
eric (oncall): Applied the rule to the two affected nodes. watch latency/5xx for next 2 mins.
sanjay (runtime): I also pushed a very small timeout bump on health-checks to avoid flapping while rollback stabilizes.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. routing-service now at v1.13 across us-east.
tom (sre): 5xx rate dropping — down to 6% now. still above baseline but trending.
eric (oncall): confirm CPU/NET on e-p-2/e-p-3?
maria (infra): CPU stable, but socket error rate rose during the fanout. looks like upstream keepalive exhaustion. I'll increase connection pool and kernel net.core.somaxconn on those nodes as a short-term fix.
sanjay (runtime): rebalancing pending requests across extra proxies to spread load. starting auto-scale of egress-proxy pool +2 instances.
eric (oncall): good. monitoring traces for root cause. any sign of a bug in routing code?
maria (infra): preliminary: the routing change introduced a lower shard dispersion (hashing tweak) — unintentionally reduced spread. will open a postmortem PR explaining the diff.
julia (product): Action item: update runbook to include hashing dispersion check when rolling routing changes. also need clearer alert that ties elevated 5xx to routing config rollouts.
eric (oncall): Agreed. I'll own the runbook update.
tom (sre): Alert tuning: raise the alert to include sustained fanout imbalance metric and add a playbook step to immediately pause routing rollouts when 5xx > 10% and upstream timeouts spike.
sanjay (runtime): Hotfix candidate: revert hashing change and add canary with stricter dispersion test in CI. I'll create PR for runtime routing lib.
maria (infra): I've applied kernel & connection pool changes. socket errors decreased. e-p nodes healthy.
eric (oncall): Last check: 5xx now 2.1% for 5m window. closing pager but we'll keep thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
julia (product): Can we prepare a short customer-facing note saying we mitigated an egress routing issue; minimal customer impact; monitoring in place? I'll draft.
eric (oncall): Drafted customer note and shared in #customer-updates for review.
sanjay (runtime): Created PR 7845 to revert hashing tweak + test. assigning reviewers: maria, tom.
maria (infra): reviewing PR now. also adding a preflight check that computes dispersion metric sample.
tom (sre): creating a post-incident task list in the incident tracker: 1) runbook update (eric) 2) alert tuning (tom) 3) CI dispersion test (sanjay) 4) kernel/pool baseline docs (maria) 5) customer note finalize (julia).
eric (oncall): I'll file the ticket and assign owners. thanks all for the quick mitigation.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: incident-id INC-2026-1971009876. resolution summary: routing change reduced shard dispersion causing concentrated fanout to egress proxies -> upstream timeouts and 502s. mitigation: rollback routing change, temp circuit-breakers, increased connection pools, autoscale +2. follow-ups assigned.
